exam_pattern.details: The selection involves two written papers conducted on the same day in two sessions: | Paper-I (Objective Screening Test): 1 hour duration, 100 marks, consisting of MCQs on General Knowledge of Himachal Pradesh (30 Marks), General Knowledge of National and International Affairs (30 Marks), Hindi language (20 Marks), and English language (20 Marks). Negative marking of 0.25 marks applies for wrong answers, unattempted questions, or blank circles (using option 'E' to avoid negative marking). Paper-II (Descriptive Subject Aptitude Test): 3 hours duration, 120 marks, based on the syllabus to be decided by the Commission. Minimum pass marks are 45% for General category and 40% for reserved categories.

how_to_apply: Visit the official website of the Commission at hppsc.hp.gov.in/hppsc and click on "Apply Online".
Click on "One Time Registration (OTR) for Examinations" and register by clicking "New Registration" if not already registered.
Log into your account on the OTR page and view live advertisements on the dashboard.
Fill out the application form for the desired post and upload requisite documents as specified in the advertisement.
Review the preview of all uploaded documents, provide the required declaration regarding readability, and pay the examination fee online.
Submit the application and keep a final printout for your records.
